description:
FILED s398 (Fable, #153 FOLD chunk 3 review probes).  PRE-EXISTING: identical on main (13bcef4) and on the chunk-3 branch — the fold changes nothing here (a whole-array condition never folds; the reducer's parse hits the same fall-through).  Occurs in NO population as a FAILING row (Mojo::DOM58 uses the ARROW spelling `if (my $t = $self->tree)->[0]`, which works).

PROBED vs perl 5.40.3 (scratchpad probes/cond.pl):
    sub f { return (0,1,2) }
    print "a\n" if (f())[1];                    perl: a      PCL: (nothing)   SILENT WRONG
    print "f\n" if (1,2)[1] == 2 && $x;         perl: f      PCL: (nothing)   SILENT WRONG
    print "c=", ((my $x = $r)->[1]), "\n";      both: c=6   (List spelling: fine)
    print "d\n" if (my $t = $r)->[0] == 5;      both: d     (Condition + ARROW: fine, Case3 handles it)
    print "e\n" unless (f())[2] != 2;           both: e     (passes BY ACCIDENT: the nil condition under `unless` prints — same bug)

EMISSION for the failing shape (./pl2cl): the condition lowers to
    (progn ;; PARSE ERROR: Bug. Fell through. Missing case: [
     nil)
— the #138/#259 silent-drop family (a PARSE ERROR comment, value nil).

CAUSE: PPI labels the leading `(…)` of a postfix-conditional CONDITION a PPI::Structure::Condition (the same mislabel PExpr.pm ~490 already handles for the SINGLE-ELEMENT case, and #153 chunk 3 W8 handles in the walker).  In parse()'s ()-replacement pass `is_list` (TokenUtils) accepts only PPI::Structure::List, so the Condition is never turned into a <tree_val> node; the legacy CtorSub branch (`Constructor after an internal node`) therefore does not fire for the `[1]` Constructor, nothing else claims `Condition Constructor`, and the loop falls through to the Missing-case die → PARSE ERROR nil.

FIX SHAPE (CLAUDE.md 11 — one predicate, not a fourth site): make the ONE paren-group predicate the expression parser uses (`is_list`, or a new `is_paren_group` that BOTH the ()-replacement and the ~490 single-element site call) accept PPI::Structure::Condition alongside List — inside an expression token array a Condition can only be this mislabel (statement-level `if (…)` conditions are split off by Parser2 before PExpr sees them; VERIFY that claim by grepping is_list callers in Parser.pm/Parser2.pm before widening).  Then delete the by-hand `List || Condition` twin at ~490 (second copy).  Guard rows in Pl/t/transpile-test-10.t: the two silent-wrong shapes above + the arrow spelling + a statement-level `if (…) {…}` inverse (probe each vs perl first).  BAR: corpus-diff (expect: only files containing the shape change — likely NONE), gate, then the sweep (compiler change).

subject: SILENT WRONG: a list slice HEADING a postfix-if/unless condition — `print 1 if (f())[1]` — is silently FALSE (PPI Condition + Constructor → Missing case → nil)
